near_miss.lead: ON 'blóð kœmr á jörðina' (blood comes onto the earth; omen speech before Stiklastaðir)
near_miss.why_not: Partners share only *h1es-/*h2egh- vocabulary (Il. 9.249 ἄχος ἔσσεται); 'blood on the ground' is generic, and ON iorð has no cognate partner in the bundle; hagiographic saga prose.

near_miss.lead: ON 'sál þín man fyrr vera í helvíti en blóð þitt sé kalt á jörðunni'
near_miss.why_not: Christian (soul in hell) curse formula; partners (Novgorod chronicle famine, Cato on wine vessels) have no congruent wording.

anchors: xcl:MH_1_2_13_Lazar_Parp ed. page 2377 - PDF page 177 (word id 63508)
near_miss.lead: ON 'hvítt sem snjór' (face white as snow) and angels bearing the soul 'til himna með miklu ljósi' ~ Arm. 'erknawor lowsov'
near_miss.why_not: Biblical/hagiographic commonplace (candidus sicut nix, heavenly light); Armenian partner is homiletic; no inherited collocation, and 'white as snow' simile is not cognate-carried in any partner.

near_miss.lead: Hom. ἀΰπνους νύκτας ἴαυον vs ON 'svaf ... um nóttina'
near_miss.why_not: Only the roots *swep- and *nokwt- co-occur; ON is a plain narrative of the king sleeping in a loft, Homer a fixed 'spend sleepless nights' line; no shared figure.

near_miss.lead: daughter + sister collocation: ON 'dóttur ... Systur', AV 'duhitā ... svasā', ORu 'сестрѹ и доцерь'
near_miss.why_not: Three branches use cognate kin terms together, but in unrelated syntax (genealogical apposition / mythic epithet / legal complaint); co-occurrence of basic kin terms is expected and not a phrase.

near_miss.lead: ON 'varð hann heill orðinn' (was healed) with *kóh2ilos; Russ. целый
near_miss.why_not: Russian bylina 'цѣла пясточка' means 'a whole fistful', not healing; ON 'verða heill' / Slavic 'быти цѣлъ' healing usage is the Gospel calque (sanus factus est), not inherited.

near_miss.lead: wound healing: ON 'grœri þegar við sem silkiþráðr væri um snúinn' (*ghreh1- 'grow' of a wound) vs healing-charm 'grow together' imagery (AV 4.12, Merseburg)
near_miss.why_not: No partner in the bundle has a healing context; the binding-with-thread image is a hagiographic miracle simile; the AV comparison uses non-cognate ruh-. Not defensible.

near_miss.lead: weapon as subject of *bheyd-: ON 'sverðet beit eigi', 'Eigi bíta vápnin' ~ Skt 'bhittvā dehaṃ gatā bhūmiṃ' (arrows split the body)
near_miss.why_not: Collocates scan of pie-root-bheyd-split shows no distinctive weapon/body pairing across branches; 'weapons bite' is a Germanic-internal idiom (cf. OE bītan of swords) and Skt bhid- 'split' of arrows is the verb's ordinary meaning; AVP 1.72 'ud bhideyam' is unrelated. Generic.

near_miss.lead: ON 'mörg stór verk ... vinna' ~ Hom. ἀμήχανα ἔργα γένοντο (*wérǵom with 'great/irresistible')
near_miss.why_not: 'do great deeds' with *wérǵom is everyday in every branch; syntax differs (verb+object vs subject of γίγνομαι); Herodotus partners irrelevant.

near_miss.lead: ON troll-woman 'Svá brenna mik nú bœnir Óláfs konungs' vs sleeping/fire partners
near_miss.why_not: Christian miracle motif (prayers burn a vættr); partners share only *swep-, *bhrenw- vocabulary; nothing congruent.

error.correct_reading: sál 'soul' < PGmc *saiwalō (Goth. saiwala); not from any *sel- root
error.evidence: Context 'sal þín man ... vera í helvíti' = your soul; the three *sel- homonyms are a form-match.
ON bœr belongs with búa, bú; no connection with bera.

error.correct_reading: Finnar = the Finns/Saami (ethnonym), should be (name) or unmapped
error.evidence: Context 'stakkum þeim er finnar höfðu gört ... með mikilli fjölkyngi' (reindeer-skin coats made by Finns with sorcery).

error.correct_reading: úbrunninn 'unburnt', negated past participle of brenna; etymon should be *bʰrenw- / the burn root, not *bʰréh₁wr̥
error.evidence: Context: fire in the town; church and houses 'sem óbrunnin váru'; brenna is mapped correctly two words earlier in the same passage.

error.passage: xcl:MH_1_1_06_Yeghishe ed. page 1002 - PDF page 482 (word id 71020)
error.correct_reading: lcʻowcʻičʻ 'filler, one who fills' (from lnowm, aor. lcʻi, caus. lcʻowcʻanem 'fill'), etymon *pleh₁-
error.evidence: Phrase 'լցուցիչն կարաւտելոց' = filler of the needy, parallel to 'tower of rain'; lowcʻanem 'kindle' does not fit.

error.passage: xcl:MH_1_2_12_Movses_Khor ed. page 2195 - PDF page 452 (word id 82336) (w3/3)
error.correct_reading: ordabowłx 'abundantly gushing' (ord- 'abundant' + bowłx 'gush'), adjective qualifying ałbewr
error.evidence: Next word is ałbewr 'spring' and verb błxē 'gushes'; ordaxowtʻiwn ('joy') is a wrong lemma.
